About Acme Cloud Analytics: We build high-throughput data processing platforms for global enterprises.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to architect and scale our real-time streaming and batch ETL data pipelines. You will collaborate closely with platform architects and data scientists to support multi-terabyte data warehousing.

Key Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain robust data pipelines using Apache Spark and Airflow.
• Design modern data warehousing solutions in Snowflake and BigQuery.
• Implement scalable streaming data ingestion with Apache Kafka.
• Optimize SQL queries, data models, and star schemas for high query performance.
• Write production ETL jobs in Python and Scala with automated data quality checks.

Requirements:
• 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or distributed systems.
• Strong proficiency in Python and advanced SQL.
• Hands-on experience with Apache Spark, Airflow, and Kafka.
• Deep understanding of data warehousing architecture and dimensional modeling.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

Nice to Have:
• Experience with dbt and Databricks.
• Exposure to AWS cloud infrastructure (S3, EC2, EMR).

Application deadline: December 15, 2026.
For inquiries, reach out to: Sarah Connor (Technical Recruiter) at sarah.connor@acmeanalytics.com or phone +1-415-555-0199.

FinTech Core Inc is modernizing digital payments and cross-border settlement infrastructure.

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Python Backend Engineer to design secure, low-latency REST APIs and microservices. You will work on financial transaction routing engines that handle millions of daily requests.

Key Responsibilities:
• Architect, build, and deploy mission-critical REST APIs using FastAPI and Django.
• Integrate with PostgreSQL databases and implement high-performance Redis caching.
• Write clean, test-driven Python code backed by comprehensive unit and integration tests.
• Collaborate with DevOps teams to deploy containerized microservices using Docker and Kubernetes.
• Enforce strict financial security standards and CI/CD automated deployment pipelines.

Requirements:
• 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.
• Expert proficiency in Python, FastAPI, or Django.
• Strong relational database skills in PostgreSQL and complex SQL queries.
• Hands-on experience with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus Qualifications:
• Experience with AWS (EC2, S3) and Terraform.
• Familiarity with message brokers such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

Contact: Reach out to Marcus Vance at marcus.talent@fintechcore.com.

NeuralVision AI pioneers computer vision and multi-modal predictive models for medical diagnostics.

Role Overview:
We are hiring a Machine Learning Scientist to lead research and deployment of predictive modeling systems. You will develop state-of-the-art architectures from raw data to production inference.

Key Responsibilities:
• Conduct feature engineering, model training, and rigorous model evaluation.
• Develop predictive algorithms using scikit-learn, PyTorch, and NLP toolkits.
• Run exploratory data analysis on large unstructured datasets using Pandas and NumPy.
• Collaborate with clinical experts to validate model interpretability and cross-validation metrics.
• Deploy scalable inference endpoints with FastAPI and Docker.

Requirements:
• Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI/ML, Statistics, or related discipline.
• 3+ years of experience training and evaluating machine learning models.
• Advanced programming in Python and machine learning libraries (scikit-learn, PyTorch, Pandas).
• Strong theoretical grounding in feature engineering and statistical analysis.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with natural language processing (NLP) and transformers.
• Familiarity with cloud model deployment on AWS or GCP.

Closing date: November 30, 2026.
Inquiries: talent@neuralvision.example.com

ScaleOps Networks automates multi-cloud infrastructure and developer developer experience for high-growth tech companies.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a Cloud DevOps Engineer to maintain our global AWS infrastructure and optimize our deployment pipelines.

Key Responsibilities:
• Provision and manage immutable infrastructure using Terraform and Ansible.
• Administer production Kubernetes clusters (EKS) and Docker containers.
• Build and improve automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Git.
• Monitor system reliability, uptime, and latency across distributed services.
• Enforce cloud security compliance across AWS S3, EC2, VPC, and IAM policies.

Requirements:
• 3+ years of experience in Cloud and DevOps engineering.
• Deep expertise in AWS (S3, EC2, IAM, CloudWatch).
• Proven track record with Docker, Kubernetes, and Linux systems administration.
• Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or shell scripting.

Nice to Have:
• Experience with Azure or GCP multi-cloud setups.
• Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog monitoring.

Application deadline: January 10, 2027. Recruiter: Alex Rivera.

Global Retail Media powers omnichannel advertising intelligence for Fortune 500 consumer brands.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst & BI Developer to transform complex retail point-of-sale data into actionable business intelligence dashboards and executive reports.

Key Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise dashboards in Power BI and Tableau.
• Write complex SQL queries, window functions, and CTEs to extract insights from PostgreSQL and Snowflake.
• Perform deep-dive statistical analysis and A/B test evaluation to guide promotional campaigns.
• Partner with product marketing and operations teams to automate weekly and monthly reporting.
• Clean and transform raw datasets using Excel and Python (Pandas).

Requirements:
• 3+ years of analytics and business intelligence experience.
• Advanced proficiency in SQL and relational databases.
• Demonstrated mastery in Power BI, Tableau, and DAX modeling.
• Strong proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, power query, advanced modeling).
• Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or related quantitative field.

Preferred Skills:
• Working knowledge of Python and Pandas for data manipulation.
• Experience with statistical analysis and hypothesis testing.

NovaWave Systems creates next-generation collaborative workspace tools for distributed engineering teams.

Role Overview:
Join our product engineering squad as a Full Stack Software Developer building real-time collaboration features.

Key Responsibilities:
• Build intuitive, responsive user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Next.js.
• Develop high-performance backend REST APIs in Node.js and Python.
• Integrate frontend state management with backend PostgreSQL and Redis instances.
• Write automated tests using Jest and Pytest to ensure code quality.
• Collaborate in an agile team using Git, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.

Requirements:
• 3+ years of full stack software engineering experience.
• Proficiency in React, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
• Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
• Solid foundation in SQL databases and schema design.
• BS degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus Skills:
• Familiarity with Docker and AWS deployment.

Apex Logistics Tech builds smart fleet dispatching and supply-chain tracking tools.

Role Overview:
We are seeking an enthusiastic Junior Data Engineer to assist in maintaining our relational database schemas, ETL pipelines, and daily operational reporting.

Key Responsibilities:
• Assist in developing data pipelines and ingestion scripts in Python.
• Maintain and write queries in PostgreSQL and MySQL databases.
• Monitor scheduled Airflow DAGs and resolve pipeline delays.
• Assist data analysts with clean data extracts and table transformations.

Requirements:
• 1+ years of experience or degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Information Systems.
• Foundational skills in Python and SQL.
• Understanding of ETL principles and relational database structures.
• Eagerness to learn Apache Spark, Docker, and cloud data warehouses.

Aether Cloud delivers enterprise-grade hybrid cloud orchestration.

Role Overview:
We are looking for a Platform Infrastructure Architect to lead architectural vision across our Kubernetes clusters, Terraform infrastructure, and microservices backends.

Key Responsibilities:
• Architect global Kubernetes multi-cluster infrastructure across AWS and GCP.
• Define Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform.
• Guide engineering teams on microservice reliability, CI/CD pipelines, and security best practices.
• Optimize cloud cost and compute utilization across large EC2 fleets.

Requirements:
• 7+ years of DevOps, infrastructure, or software engineering experience.
• Mastery of Kubernetes, Docker, and Linux internals.
• Deep expertise in AWS cloud services and Terraform.
• Excellent communication and architectural documentation skills.
